name: Chaga Extract – 120 Capsules
description:
Chaga mushroom extract powder | Mushroom powder capsules | Shroom powder capsules 

Chaga Extract – 120 Capsules Chaga Extract Mushroom Capsules

Number of capsules: 120 caps

Capsule size: Size 0

Net Content Capsules: 400mg

Dosage: Take 1 capsule twice a day with water during the meal.

Common name(s): The diamond of the forest, Berkenweerschijnzwam

Chaga Mushroom Dual Extract;

Chaga (Inonotus Obliquus) also called the diamond of the forest, can be supportive against viruses, is a very strong antioxidant and much research has been done into the effect of Chaga against certain forms of cancer. This Chaga is often used to get a balance in the immune system, this is partly due to the following substances: betulinic acids, ergosterol, fecosterol and epsterol.

Ingredients per vegetarian capsule:

400 mg organic Chaga (inonotus obliquus) extract of 100% fruiting body (sclerotia). It is a full-spectrum extract obtain by means of H2O and ethanol. This is to get the most out of the fruiting bodies. It contains 35% polysaccharides, betulin, betulinic acid and sterols.

Excipients: Magnesium Citrate and Silicon Dioxide

Chaga Mushroom Extract Powder Can provide assistance with:

– The substances from the Chaga fungus can have a powerful effect against cancer cells.

– Due to the many antioxidants that the Chaga contains, it can slow down the natural process of aging.

– Decrease in the symptoms of psoriasis.

– Building an overall stronger immune system, which could make viral infections less likely.

Warning:

Keep out of reach of children.

Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have health problems.

This is a dietary supplement and should be use as such.

short_description: Chaga is nutrient-rich and contains fiber, vitamin D, iron, magnesium and potassium. The Chaga also has a very high antioxidant content. Antioxidants are very important for the body and can detect and eliminate free radicals. These free radicals are produced by the body when it is exposed to, for example, stress, air pollution or medication
